error.noGpu.title: This device can't run the game's graphics
error.noGpu.body: Try the latest Chrome, Edge or Safari with WebGPU or WebGL 2 enabled.
error.boot.title: Something went wrong while loading
error.boot.body: Reload the page to try again. If it keeps happening, open the debug overlay (F3 or a three-finger tap) and share the error.

a2hs.title: Play in full screen
a2hs.ios: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. It also keeps your progress safe.
a2hs.android: Install the game for full screen and offline-ready loading.
sandbox.hint: Movement sandbox — WASD or left stick to move, Space or A to jump
